objective: Verify that Sort works as a separate module with its own source, layout, style, and resolver behavior.
preconditions: Sort is enabled independently from filters.
The target listing has title, date, numeric, rating, and custom data keys.
steps: Enable Sort with default, title, date, numeric, rating, and data-key options.
Assign Sort a non-100 layout width when supported.
Style Sort independently from generic fields.
Select each sort option and verify listing order.
Disable Sort and verify Sort style controls disappear.
expected_result: Sort behaves as a mature sibling module, not as an afterthought inside Filters.
pass_criteria: sort data key selection is explicit.
sort styling is independent from unrelated filter families.
sort layout can participate in the controller layout policy when intended.
disabled sort does not leave stale URL state.
